newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price - USDA.

text.p: USDA reported Monday that one lot of steers weighing 300 lbs was imported at 63 cents/lb through Nogales, Arizona, Friday, as part of a total 1,500 heads of feeding steers imported from Mexico.
About 1,000 head of mostly 300 to 500 lb steers were imported through Nogales, the USDA said.
An estimated 500 head were imported through Santa Teresa, New Mexico. Sales included a previously contracted lot of 400- to 600-lb steers and 300 head of "corriente" steers weighing 300-500 lbs.
The USDA said not enough head went through Santa Teresa for indicative market prices.
